query: SELECT r.kind AS "kind!: String", r.id AS "id!: String", r.payload AS "payload!: String", CASE WHEN r.kind = 'workTrailRow' THEN t.redacted END AS "redacted: bool" FROM json_each(?) k CROSS JOIN record_identities r ON r.kind = json_extract(k.value, '$[0]') AND r.id = json_extract(k.value, '$[1]') LEFT JOIN work_trail_rows t ON t.row_id = r.id ORDER BY r.kind, r.id
